scope: Adjudicate all23remaining development Java-screen-flagged source families with explicit actual-source behavioral contracts. No model fitting in this corpus-curation stage.
inputPolicy: Use unchanged original drivers and original candidate programs. Freeze exact argument mappings, source/probe/helper hashes and exclusions before each cohort executes.
Fixed OCCURS arrays require explicit Java lengths and full initialization; do not silently add values.
COBOL PIC limits, encoding, padding and precision define shared-input boundaries.
COMP-2 maps to Java Double; integer-looking MOVE syntax does not establish an Integer runtime type.
Interface adaptations require an explicit original contract; do not rename candidate methods to force compatibility.
outputPolicy: Compare actual original COBOL execution, not declared benchmark expected answers.
Canonical Java is a separate control and can itself disagree with the source. Retain both observations.
List prefixes require an independent source-derived logical length and explicit tail/shape inspection; report them as projected contracts rather than full-language equivalence.
Never strip significant whitespace or choose floating tolerances after seeing candidate differences.
Source-reference disagreement may reflect an original source bug, desired policy change or lost representation. Keep it distinct from a strong source-fidelity discrepancy with agreeing controls.
reporting: Every23familymusthaveexplicit disposition and evidence/reason, including unexecuted/unsupported cases.
Count faulty candidate programs and distinct source-task groups separately from driver witnesses.
Keep historical reports immutable; preserve raw outputs and source bytes in ignored cache with versioned hash pointers.
All cohorts are selected after screening: do not interpret discrepancy prevalence as detector accuracy or unbiased generalization.
No independent human-review votes, gold localization labels or unmeasured model performance are created.
trainingDecision: Decide data readiness from reproduced independent source families, controls and review coverage after adjudication. Do not relabel Java-test-only failures or representation conflicts as semantic defects to increase the training count.
aiDisclosure: AI-generated protocol, adapters and local peer checks; not independent human adjudication.
